item.summary: docs(skills): document session and transcript fetching in openclaw-debugging (#122904) Adds a Fetching Sessions and Transcripts section: sessions CLI first, then the per-agent SQLite data plane (session_nodes lookup from chat URL fragments, transcript_events shape, __openclaw sender provenance, session_transcript_fts, media://inbound mapping) and a dependency-free node:sqlite read-only recipe for hosts without sqlite3. Read-only-against- live-gateway rule stated inline.
